text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day, Rice Shower ran into Special 
Week and Silence Suzuka by chance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After receiving an invitation, we ended 
up going to a family restaurant together, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Special Week stepped away from 
the table, the conversation had died down 
completely.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(W-What do I do...? I-I've gotta say 
something, right...?)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...S-Spe-chan, it sounded like a call 
from your mother... You looked so happy."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Y-Yeah. They looked happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Aaaah... Our talk ended already! Stupid 
Rice, stupid stupid!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, I can't let things stay like this... 
Rice has to say something too!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, I-I'm sorry! Please, after you...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, it's fine. Please, after you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Um... it's a, nice day, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah. It's neither hot nor cold, 
looks like it'll be really easy to run—

text_block_list.name: Rushing Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! This is the absolute worst! It 
started pouring out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Rushing Customer B
text_block_list.text:
It was cloudy all day today after all~. 
Ah, I really should've brought an 
umbrella.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, silence lingered in the 
air until Special Week returned.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I wanted to chat and get along with 
them, but I just couldn't do it right...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san is amazing... and I respect her 
so much. And yet I made her worry about 
me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother. What do you think I should 
do...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Onee-sama. What do you think I should 
do...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you wish to get along 
naturally. If so, wouldn't asking fellow 
students—your friends—be the best 
approach?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Take Haru Urara, Twin Turbo, Narita Top 
Road, for example... All of them seem like 
the type who could chat without feeling 
intimidated.
choice_data_list:
And then we actually test that method out, 
or something.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I-I wonder if Rice can do it.
choice_data_list: We've gotta give everything a shot!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y... Yeah. You're right, I have to try. 
Rice, do your best~. Yay~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You wanna be friends? It's super easy! 
Just tell them, 'I like you, so let's be 
friends!' That's all it takes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-Suzuka-san... has such a beautiful 
running form, and I respect her so much... 
So, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might not be very good at talking with 
others, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice likes you! I want to be friends with 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: R-Rice...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I feel the same way. I'm always 
captivated by the sight of you powerfully 
charging straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So... I'd be delighted if we could become 
friends."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yeah. Thank you...! I-I'm in your 
care...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. It's kind of embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Nn... That's true. Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Haru Urara's advice was a 
resounding success.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Get along? We should just have a race 
instead!! Fight with everything we've got! 
Turbo at full throttle! Ah, Rice, wanna 
race Turbo!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Compete... with me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. Is that not okay...? I want to 
run... with Suzuka-san. If I do that—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, gladly. Let us head out at 
once. As for the race distance, let us 
consider our aptitudes—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, wa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An all-out match—Rice Shower had been a 
bit worried whether they'd be able to get 
along, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*... That felt amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...! I feel... so refreshed...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That drive I felt from behind me... 
I want to feel it again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Will you... run with me again sometime?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! O-Of course! I should be the one asking. 
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Twin Turbo's advice was a 
success.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Getting along... you say? In that case, 
shouldn't we start by getting to know each 
other! Like our hobbies, or how we spend 
our days off!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-What are your hobbies...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
R-Running, I suppose... What about you, 
Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Rice also likes running, and... also 
drawing pictures, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So, you paint on your days off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. What about Suzuka-san...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...She's running.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so. Then... um, what kind of 
food do you like...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...It feels like an arranged marriage 
meeting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watch over the two as their awkward 
conversation continues. I'm not so sure 
their goal of "becoming good friends" is 
being achieved, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they've managed to get to know 
each other. Does that mean Narita Top 
Road's advice was decent enough?
